claims.text: Role in cor pulmonale: tx is directed at the cause;
claims.quote: Treatment of right heart failure consists of identifying and treating the underlying cause.
claims.locator: Treatment of Right Heart Failure and Cor Pulmonale › Treatment of cause

claims.text: acute causes incl massive pulmonary embolization.
When the cause is acute PE: initial, then maintenance anticoagulation is indicated (prevents further embolization and new clot);
claims.quote: Initial anticoagulation followed by maintenance anticoagulation is indicated for patients with acute pulmonary embolism to prevent further embolization as well as new clot formation.

claims.text: dabigatran is effective for acute DVT and PE;
claims.quote: The direct thrombin inhibitor dabigatran is also effective for treatment of acute DVT and PE.

claims.text: as initial tx it needs overlap w a parenteral anticoagulant.
claims.quote: Dabigatran requires overlap with a parenteral anticoagulant when used as initial therapy.

claims.text: Interactions: ⍉P-gp inducers (eg, RIF), which lower dabigatran levels;
claims.quote: The concomitant use of PRADAXA with P-gp inducers (e.g., rifampin) reduces exposure to dabigatran and should generally be avoided
claims.locator: 5.5 Effect of P-gp Inducers and Inhibitors on Dabigatran Exposure

claims.text: Counseling: swallow capsules whole w a full glass of H2O;
claims.quote: PRADAXA Capsules should be swallowed whole. PRADAXA Capsules should be taken with a full glass of water.

claims.text: breaking, chewing or emptying them raises exposure.
claims.quote: Breaking, chewing, or emptying the contents of the capsule can result in increased exposure

claims.text: Don't stop early: premature discontinuation raises thrombotic risk.
claims.quote: Premature discontinuation of any oral anticoagulant, including PRADAXA, increases the risk of thrombotic events.
claims.locator: WARNING: (A) PREMATURE DISCONTINUATION OF PRADAXA INCREASES THE RISK OF THROMBOTIC EVENTS, and (B) SPINAL/EPIDURAL HEMATOMA

claims.text: Reversal for emergency surg or urgent procedures:
claims.quote: Use a specific reversal agent (idarucizumab) in case of emergency surgery or urgent procedures
claims.locator: 2.8 Discontinuation for Surgery and Other Interventions

claims.quote: The recommended dose of PRAXBIND is 5 g, provided as two separate vials each containing 2.5 g/50 mL idarucizumab
